threads.body: [General] The URI is associated only when `connectStandalone` exits, but the non-default-database `SELECT` is dispatched while that method is still running (the new setup test notes that this span is nested under `CONNECT`). Its command therefore sees an unset `CONNECTION_URI` and still omits stable `db.namespace`, contrary to the PR's guarantee that every Redis client span has it. Associate the URI before connection-initialization commands are dispatched, and assert the generated `SELECT` span.

replies.body:
Good catch, fixed. Attaching on exit of `connectStandalone` was too late for the `SELECT` that lettuce sends while connecting to a non-default database.

The URI is now attached on **entry** of `RedisClient.connectStateful` / `connectStatefulAsync`, which takes the `StatefulRedisConnectionImpl` and the `RedisURI` as arguments, so the virtual field is set before lettuce dispatches any connect-time command. This mirrors what lettuce 5.0 already does in `LettuceClientInstrumentation.AttachEndpointAdvice`. I checked with `javap` that the method exists with that signature across 4.0.Final through 4.5.0.Final (`connectStateful` in 4.0-4.3, `connectStatefulAsync` in 4.4+), and the matcher covers both.

`testNonDefaultDatabaseIndexOnConnect` in both modules now asserts the generated `SELECT` span carries `db.namespace`, so the behavior is proved rather than claimed. It asserts the span rather than the enclosing trace because the `SELECT` nests under `CONNECT` on lettuce 4.0 but starts its own trace on 4.5 and 5.x. Muzzle and the `testLatestDeps` runs pass.

threads.body: [Testing] Repository Java test conventions prohibit adding `@Nullable` to test code. Please remove this annotation and its import; the assertion helper can still return the conditional null expected value without a test-source nullability annotation.

replies.body: Removed the annotation and its import. `.github/instructions/java-style.instructions.md` says not to use `@Nullable` in test code, so this was against the repo rule.
